title: can we do this walking? i’ve got a flight.
old_caption:
Behind the sign: Sagittarius admits it leaves first so it's never left. Freedom can sometimes be a way of staying safe.
If you love a Sag, be patient. They're learning to land.

title: before we start. who sent you?
old_caption:
Behind the sign: Scorpio reads everything because it's been hurt before, and loves all in once it trusts you. Ask about the soft part; there's a lot of it.
Trust takes time. Once earned, it's deep.

title: you want the story? sit down. this takes a minute.
old_caption:
Behind the sign: Taurus is slow because it's sure, loves through food and holding hands, and is scared of change it didn't choose.
Give your Taurus a heads-up, and ask if they're okay too.

title: sorry, one sec. just fixing the lighting. okay.
old_caption: Virgo fixes everything because part of it believes perfect means nobody leaves. If that's you: you don't have to be finished to be loved. Let someone see you tired, too.

title: the point
old_caption: Sagittarius with the bow drawn, Scorpio with the tail up, and it turns out both are doing it for the exact same reason. The sky has had them aimed at each other for ages. Who are you in a standoff with?

title: a campfire, the last night of the season
old_caption: All twelve signs around one fire, one true thing each, and Ophiuchus finally gets a log of its own. Season finale, and it turns out this family is very, very old. Who would you sit next to?

title: season starters
old_caption: Aries, Cancer, Libra and Capricorn planned one group trip: four mood boards, one spreadsheet, zero dates. Classic season starters. Who in your chat starts everything?

title: southern claw
old_caption: Scorpio and Libra in a diner booth at 1 a.m., fries between them, ex-best friends. Turns out Libra's stars used to be the Scorpion's claws. And someone is still stealing fries. Who's your ex-bestie sign?

title: a seesaw, after dark
old_caption: Aries slams the seesaw down, Libra is stuck in the air. Same seesaw, different speeds. It only levels out when both of them scoot. Which one are you in your relationship?

title: CAST AS THE VILLAIN?
old_caption: Cancer and Leo started a support group of two for signs cast as the villain in old myths. He wore Leo's coat. He stepped on Cancer mid-fight. Which sign feels most misunderstood?
